title: Vault secrets integration and per-environment configuration
objective: All secrets (DB, Keycloak admin, S3/MinIO, Hangfire) come from HashiCorp Vault in every environment including local; per-environment appsettings files exist for local/dev/qa/stage/uat/prod with placeholders (spec §8, §16, Q-7).
scope: Vault configuration provider loading secrets into IConfiguration at startup, fail-fast with a clear error listing missing keys
appsettings.Local.json fully working; appsettings.{Development,QA,Staging,UAT,Production}.json with placeholder Vault paths/endpoints
Local compose Vault (dev mode) seeded with local secrets by an init script
No secret values in any checked-in file
implementation_details: Use VaultSharp (MIT). Infrastructure/Secrets/VaultConfigurationSource.cs + VaultConfigurationProvider.cs reading KV v2 mount 'quoteiq' path per environment (e.g., quoteiq/local/db, quoteiq/local/keycloak, quoteiq/local/s3)
Program.cs: builder.Configuration.AddVault(options from appsettings: Vault address, mount, base path; token auth locally via VAULT_TOKEN env var, AppRole placeholders for hosted envs)
Secrets consumed as standard configuration keys: ConnectionStrings:QuoteIq, Keycloak:AdminClientSecret, S3:AccessKey, S3:SecretKey, Hangfire:ConnectionString
infra/vault/seed-local-secrets.sh executed by a compose init container: writes postgres, keycloak admin, minio keys into Vault dev instance
Startup validation class SecretsStartupCheck: verifies presence of required keys, throws with the list of missing keys (never their values)
Testcontainers-based fixture VaultContainerFixture for integration tests

integration: Repository scan check: no secret literals in appsettings files
